_comment: SECURITY, NOT A COMPANY. SGPLR is the tradable right entitlement of S.G. Power Limited, not an issuer — so every company field is null and products is empty by design. Terms below are from the issuer's own PSX filing of 18 May 2026 and its 17 September 2026 allotment notice. No image is attached.
description: SGPLR is the renounceable right entitlement issued by S.G. Power Limited, not a company in its own right. Each holder of S.G. Power ordinary shares was offered approximately 3 right shares for every 1 share held — a 300% issue at par of Rs 10 per share, 53,499,600 shares in total, declared by the board on 18 May 2026. Subscription reached about 92.99% of the Rs 534,996,000 issue; the board allotted the unsubscribed portion of 3,749,635 shares on 17 September 2026.
sourceNote: S.G. Power Limited's PSX filings: declaration of right shares dated 18 May 2026 and board decisions on allotment of the unsubscribed portion dated 17 September 2026, read 2026-10-17.
